$comment: Bundle composition budgets for the client (browser) bundle. Read scripts/bundle/README.md before changing anything here: every route budget needs a non-empty reason and an ISO reviewedOn date, and ANY edit to this file invalidates baseline.json until `npm run bundle:baseline` is re-run and committed in the same pull request.

/.reason: Marketing home page: the shared app-router client runtime plus the public shell only. Budget is the measured 2026-08-28 baseline (598746 B) plus ~2% headroom for framework patch bumps.

/about.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/contact.reason: Adds the interactive contact form client component (~6 KB over the static-content routes).

/developers.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/faq.reason: Ships the FAQ data module and its interactive disclosure components on top of the public shell.

/how-it-works.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/issuers.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/privacy.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/proofs/create.reason: Highest budget in the app: the proof creation flow plus the credential export helpers. @stellar/freighter-api is loaded on demand and is deliberately NOT part of this route's first load - the allowlist, not this number, is what keeps it that way.

/status.reason: Adds the health-check client module and the network badge to the public shell.

/terms.reason: Static content route sharing the public shell with / and carrying no route-specific client code.

/verify.reason: Public verification entry point: verification panel, proof form and QR payload validation.

/verify/credential.reason: Credential verification form plus the disclosure rendering used by the verification panel.

/verify/scan.reason: Camera scan surface plus the QR payload validator; no scanner library ships in first load.
